name: @dna/argmap
description: argmap: an article's argument as one hand-drawn Excalidraw image (10 layouts), rendered to PNG in headless Chromium

scripts.build: esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=web/bundle.js --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --log-level=warning && rm -rf web/fonts && cp -R ../../../../node_modules/@excalidraw/excalidraw/dist/prod/fonts web/fonts
